dict.string: MacBroom asks Finder to put an item back from the Trash when macOS does not allow it to move the item itself.
MacBroom scans your Desktop to report large and old files. Nothing is removed without your confirmation.
MacBroom scans your Documents to report large and old files. Nothing is removed without your confirmation.
MacBroom scans your Downloads for stale installers and large files. Nothing is removed without your confirmation.
MacBroom can scan external volumes for large files when you choose them.
